+### FIN-06.09 — The budget grouped by kind, collapsed, no letters on the glass
+
+**Statement.** The budget table groups the plan's lines by the sheet's kinds — Income · Fixed · Variable (· Transfers when present) — in that order, one row per kind with its total in the chosen unit and a chevron; the groups start collapsed and edit mode opens them; a line shows its section by icon and name; no A–U letter reaches the glass anywhere (the table, the pickers, the heading); a kind with nothing on the plan prints no row.
